dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, thick white bands formed by broad feather tips across the covert rows against a dark gray-brown ground.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent and sharp pale white boundaries on the edges of the dark folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct and linear transition from the solid dark gray crown/nape to the heavily white-scalloped mantle.
